announcements.title: Online Quran Classes
announcements.content:
Mahmud Sabir (Alfurqan) Masjid announces online Qur’an classes for children & beginners, covering basic recitation to confident reading, with certificates & Quran competitions.
Class details: Tues & Thurs 5–7 PM, for ages 7+. Limited spaces.
Teacher: Sheikh Mohammed Khattab, Al-Azhar graduate, 30 yrs’ experience in teaching Quran.( Teacher at Dar Al-Ulum- Al Islamiya School)
Fees: £50 per month, starts Thurs 2 April 2026. 
For more info/register: 07821 107072.

announcements.title: Qurbani / Udhiya 2026
announcements.content:
Al-Furqan Relief Trust is a registered charity running Qurbani programmes in Kenya, Uganda, Pakistan, and for Gaza. Your Qurbani is managed directly by our experienced teams, helping provide meat to needy families who may only eat it once a year.

• 100% donation policy
• Competitive animal prices
• Trusted distribution
Donate via the Mawaqit "information" link or contact 07821 107072.

announcements.title: Maximise the Blessed Days of Dhul Hijjah
announcements.content:
The best days of the year are here! 
Prepare for Dhul Hijjah by automating your donations and earn immense rewards in these sacred days. 
Your support helps provide food, relief and care to the poor, widows and orphans in Gaza, Pakistan, Kenya and Uganda. 
Even a small daily donation can become a source of lasting Sadaqah Jariyah.
Please click on the "information" button to donate.
